$comment: Provisional format until phase 4.4 (kui-tooling parity) defines the schema. One record per component deliberately absent from a sibling repo.

exceptions.name: SchemaForm
exceptions.reason: New in phase 9 (9.10, OD-16), no counterpart. kui-ejs deliberately reverted FormBuilder, so no schema form is added there without a scope decision; KUInative has no form-builder surface. Source of truth for next-boilerplate's FieldSchema, vendored back from here.

exceptions.name: ContributionBoundary
exceptions.reason: A React error boundary isolates contributed UI at render time (next-boilerplate phase 37). kui-ejs renders on the server, so there is no client render to isolate: a failing contribution is caught by the host route and rendered as the UnavailableContribution partial, which both repos have. KUInative keeps an equivalent private to TabGroup (isolate) and exports none until a native host needs one.
